status_message: Sketchware AI v2.1.6 is required: the GitHub + JSON Live Demo, the sign-in window opens by itself when GitHub ends a sign-in (waiting backups go on after it), 8-digit codes are matched, follow notifications can be switched off, and the app checks its own signature. Tap Update: it installs over this version and your projects stay.
update_reason: This update is required: it fixes problems in the version you have, and that version is no longer supported. It installs over it: your projects, settings and GitHub sign-in stay.
update_notes: GitHub + JSON Live Demo, first in Restore → Demo
Sign-in opens by itself when GitHub ends it; backups go on
Switch off follow notifications in Settings
update_fixes: A 6-digit code never goes into GitHub's 8-digit field
The security log note names your signed-in account
Signature check, token only to GitHub's API, safer updates
